_meta.zipToCbsa: DERIVED, not HUD: HUD USPS ZIP-CBSA crosswalk requires a HUD API token (sign-up), so ZIP->CBSA is built from Census 2020 ZCTA-to-county relationship file (tab20_zcta520_county20_natl.txt; county with largest land-area share) + OMB/Census July 2023 CBSA delineation file (list1_2023.xlsx). ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIPs; PO-box-only ZIPs are absent. Estimated mapping.
_meta.zip3ToState: Majority state of 2020 ZCTAs per 3-digit prefix (fallback when ZIP is not in a covered metro).
